_how_to: Create each voice in ElevenLabs (Voices > Voice Design, or search the Voice Library for 'Ugandan'), then paste its voice_id here. The 'design' text is the prompt to use in Voice Design.

conductor_m.design: A Ugandan man in his mid-20s, a Kampala matatu taxi conductor. Loud, slightly hoarse from shouting all day, fast rhythmic street calls, strong Luganda accent when speaking English, energetic and cheeky. Recorded outdoors at a busy roadside.

boda_m.design: A Ugandan man in his early 30s, a Kampala boda boda (motorcycle taxi) rider. Friendly, relaxed and confident, Luganda-accented English, a little playful, speaks at a natural street pace.

vendor_m.design: A Ugandan man in his 30s, a roadside rolex and muchomo seller in Kampala. Loud, cheerful, persuasive calls to passers-by, Luganda-accented English, warm laugh in his voice.

vendor_f.design: A Ugandan woman in her 40s, a market seller at a busy Kampala market. Warm, loud, motherly and persuasive, calling customers, Luganda-accented English.

mc_m.design: A Ugandan man in his late 20s who calls people into a Kampala kibanda video hall and bar. Excitable, booming, like a local radio presenter, Luganda-accented English.

police_m.design: A Ugandan traffic police officer in his 40s. Stern, authoritative, slow and firm, Ugandan accent, speaking at a roadside checkpoint.

customer_f.design: A Ugandan woman in her late 20s, an office worker in Kampala. Polite but quick and a little impatient, clear Kampala accent, natural everyday English with Luganda words.

customer_m.design: A Ugandan man in his 50s, a Kampala businessman. Easy-going, warm, deep voice, Luganda-accented English.

pastor_m.design: A Ugandan Pentecostal pastor in his 40s. Powerful, joyful, preaching voice with call-and-response energy, Ugandan accent.
